Context: 1. T.A. and Joining Time

...  
If the family accompanies him, he can draw the existing T.A., including the cost of transporting personal effects to his maximum entitlement. Production of receipts/vouchers is mandatory in respect of transfer cases of North-Eastern Region, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep and Ladakh. - OM, dated 16-6-2022.  
These provisions apply also for the return journey on transfer back  
from the North-Eastern Region/Union Territory.
